QuestInfo.name: Collecting 150 Cursed Dolls
QuestInfo.parent: Oldmaple-Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll
QuestInfo.1: Rowen asks for your help again, this time to collect #b150 Cursed Dolls#k. Now that's a lot of Cursed Dolls!\n\n#i4000031# #t4000031# #b#c4000031##k/150
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated a bunch of Zombie Lupins in a forest near Ellinia and collected all #b150 Cursed Dolls#k for Rowen. In return, she gave you the Scroll for gloves. You hope the forest will return to normal...

0.0: Traveler, you've returned... I've sealed the doll that you gave me deep in the dark forest. But the Zombie #o3210800#s are still increasing in numbers... Can you please bring me 150 #b#t4000031#s#k?

yes.0: Thank you so much. The #o4230101#s are often seen in the Dark Tree Forest near #m101000000#. Just bring me #b150#k #b#t4000031#s#k.

no.0: I see... I thought I could count on you for this, but if you are busy, then it's understandable. Please come back if you ever have a change of heart in the near future.

1.0: This is... Wow! You've brought me 150 #t4000031#s! That means you've thinned out the #o4230101#s. But it's too early to be relieved, because this doll is capable of continuously making new puppets.
1.1: Oh yeah, take this as a token of my appreciation. The fairies will spread word of your good deed. I personally think you deserve to be called a hero, and not just because you save me from a pickle!

yes.0: I have increased your fame a little. I am also giving you this scroll that I made myself based on what I've learned from #p1032001#. So long.

item.0: So, you weren't able to collect 150 #b#t4000031#s#k yet. The #t4000031# is making more Puppets of itself as we speak. You need to hurry up and bring me the dolls.
